title: OmniVideo-R1: Reinforcing Audio-visual Reasoning with Query Intention and Modality Attention
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical improvements for audio-visual reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) using reinforcement learning. It discusses 'modality bias' (the tendency of models to over-rely on one sense, like vision, over another, like audio) but does not evaluate or benchmark themes related to religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
